title: Recital preparation: waqf and ibtida' in Al-Insan: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 49 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recital preparation rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 49. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا (٢١)

panels.title: Stopping on endings
points: Dammatan or kasratan: drop the vowel
«سَلَٰسِلَا۟» at a stop: with or without the alif

keywords.def: stopping on a word, with a breath

questions.q: Recite 76:21 stopping at ۖ and restarting at «وَحُلُّوٓا۟».
Recital plan (pupil PDF): mark your stops and breaths for the whole surah. Today's rota group recites 76:11 to 31.
questions.a: Stops at ayah ends and signs; breaths at sound places.

questions.q: Extend: rehearse the plan once with a partner listening.
Stretch: why might a reciter join 76:5 and 76:6?
questions.a: 76:6 describes the 'ayn of 76:5's drink: the meaning flows, so joining is good if breath allows.
A) stop or continue equally. ۚ: equal.

questions.q: Think again: In a recital, which matters more: speed or sound stops?
questions.a: Sound stops and clear tajweed; tarteel is measured.
